sections.name: chargebee_api_configuration
sections.description: Chargebee API host settings used when calling subscription APIs.

parameters.name: api_host_suffix
parameters.description: Example: .devcb.in or .chargebee.com. Default is .devcb.in when empty.

sections.name: advance_invoice_configuration
sections.description: Advance invoice schedule settings applied on subscription_created.

parameters.name: schedule_type
parameters.description: fixed: create invoice a few days before every renewal; specific: create invoice on the exact date you set.

parameters.name: days_before_renewal
parameters.description: How many days before each interval the advance invoice is generated. Ignored when schedule_type is specific.

parameters.name: terms_to_charge
parameters.description: Number of subscription billing cycles covered per advance invoice (minimum 1).

parameters.name: specific_invoice_date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD for the first specific-date advance invoice. Required when schedule_type is specific; ignored for fixed.
